controles.affirmation: BPA prefe publie -8,3% a 2,44 EUR contre 2,66 EUR ; BPA ajuste +1,8% a 2,86 EUR
controles.verbatim_source: Earnings per preferred share in euros | 2.66 | 2.44 | -8.3% ; Adjusted earnings per preferred share in euros | 2.81 | 2.86 | 1.8% (CP S1 2026, tableau Key figures)

controles.affirmation: EBIT publie du groupe -7,6% a 1 424 M EUR ; EBIT ajuste 1 620 M EUR contre 1 614 M EUR
Position financiere nette passee de +109 M EUR au 31/12/2025 a -1 855 M EUR au 30/06/2026, du fait des acquisitions closes et du rachat d'actions
controles.verbatim_source: Net financial position stood at -1,855 million euros as of June 30, 2026 (December 31, 2025: 109 million euros), mainly reflecting cash outflows related to the recently closed acquisitions and the share buyback program. (CP S1 2026)

controles.affirmation: Hook : position financiere nette 'negative de 1,9 Md EUR'
controles.verbatim_source: -1,855 million euros (CP S1 2026). Arrondi a 1,9 Md EUR acceptable ; le basculement de 1 964 M EUR justifie 'pres de 2 Mds EUR' dans l'argument.

controles.affirmation: EBIT publie Consumer Brands -11,3% a 643 M EUR contre 725 ; EBIT ajuste 748 -> 724 M EUR ; marge ajustee stable a 15,3% ; CA en repli nominal de 3,5%
controles.verbatim_source: Consumer Brands | 2026 | 2,448 | 4,733 | 643 | 13.6% ; 2025 | 2,422 | 4,907 | 725 | 14.8% ; 2026 adjusted | 724 | 15.3% ; 2025 adjusted | 748 | 15.3% ; 'representing a nominal decrease of -3.5 percent' ; 'adjusted return on sales remained unchanged at 15.3 percent' (CP S1 2026). 643/725 = -11,31%.

controles.affirmation: Croissance organique Consumer Brands +1,7% portee par Cheveux +4,2% ; Autres marques grand public -2,1%
controles.verbatim_source: Organically, sales increased by 1.7 percent (Q2: +1.6 percent) ; The Hair business area achieved very strong organic sales growth of 4.2 percent ... and was therefore the main driver of growth in the Consumer Brands business unit ; The Other Consumer Businesses business area, in contrast, recorded a negative organic sales development of -2.1 percent (CP S1 2026)

controles.affirmation: Europe -1,5% organique (T2 +0,4%), Amerique latine -1,3%, Amerique du Nord +2,4%, IMEA +14,9%, Asie-Pacifique +10,3%
controles.verbatim_source: The Europe region recorded a negative organic sales development of -1.5 percent (Q2: +0.4 percent). In contrast, North America achieved good organic growth of 2.4 percent ... IMEA and Asia-Pacific regions ... 14.9 percent ... and 10.3 percent ... The Latin America region, in contrast, recorded a slightly negative organic sales development of -1.3 percent (CP S1 2026)

controles.affirmation: BFR net en % du CA du T2 passe de 6,0% a 7,0%, attribue en partie aux acquisitions
controles.verbatim_source: Net working capital as a percentage of second-quarter sales increased from 6.0 percent to 7.0 percent compared with the prior-year period, driven in part by acquisitions. (CP S1 2026)

controles.affirmation: 5 Mds EUR sur cinq acquisitions, quatre deja closes, ~1,6 Md EUR de CA annuel combine, ~700 M EUR de ventes en 2026, au moins 10% du BPA ajuste d'ici 2030
controles.verbatim_source: Henkel is investing a total of 5 billion euros and expanding its business by combined annual sales of approximately 1.6 billion euros. To date, Henkel has successfully completed four of the five transactions ; In 2026, the acquired businesses are expected to contribute approximately 700 million euros in sales ; Henkel expects the acquisitions to contribute at least 10 percent to adjusted earnings per preferred share by 2030 (CP S1 2026)

controles.affirmation: Titre du bloc quantitatif : '5 Mds EUR engages en acquisitions pour un rendement attendu surtout APRES 2030'
controles.verbatim_source: Henkel expects the acquisitions to contribute at least 10 percent to adjusted earnings per preferred share BY 2030 ; combined sales projected to increase to around 2 billion euros BY 2030 (CP S1 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le communique dit 'd'ici 2030' (by 2030), pas 'apres 2030'. Le titre repousse l'echeance au-dela de ce que dit la source, alors que le corps du texte de l'ATT ecrit correctement 'd'ici 2030'. Remplacer par 'pour un rendement attendu surtout a horizon 2030'.

controles.affirmation: Bloc quantitatif : 'la DETTE NETTE a deja bascule en territoire NEGATIF des le premier semestre 2026'
controles.verbatim_source: Net financial position stood at -1,855 million euros as of June 30, 2026 (December 31, 2025: 109 million euros) (CP S1 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Inversion logique : c'est la POSITION FINANCIERE NETTE qui est devenue negative, ce qui signifie que le groupe est passe en dette nette. Une 'dette nette negative' signifierait au contraire une tresorerie nette excedentaire, soit l'inverse de ce que l'ATT veut dire. Ecrire : 'alors que la position financiere nette a deja bascule en territoire debiteur des le premier semestre 2026'. Le titre du bloc fondamental et le glossaire emploient eux la bonne formulation.

controles.affirmation: Les actions HEN3 cotees au DAX (178 162 875 titres, 40,7% du capital) ne donnent aucun droit de vote ; seules les HEN ordinaires votent
controles.verbatim_source: 259,795,875 are ordinary shares (total nominal proportion of capital stock: 259,795,875 euros, representing 59.3 percent of the capital stock), and 178,162,875 are preferred shares without voting rights (total nominal proportion of capital stock: 178,162,875 euros, representing 40.7 percent of the capital stock) (Rapport annuel 2025, p. 35). Confirme aussi par 'Comprising: 259,795,875 ordinary shares, 178,162,875 non-voting preferred shares' (notes aux comptes) et par la fiche Share data (HEN3.ETR).

controles.affirmation: Le pacte des descendants du fondateur Fritz Henkel detenait 61,85% des droits de vote au 21 mars 2025
controles.verbatim_source: According to notifications received by the Company as of March 21, 2025, a total of 61.85 percent of the voting rights are held by members of the Henkel family share-pooling agreement (Rapport annuel 2025, gouvernance). Recoupe par la Note : 'on March 19, 2025, the proportion of voting rights held by the members of the Henkel family share-pooling agreement represented in total a share of 61.85 percent of the voting rights (160,677,029 votes)' et '143 members of the families of the descendants of Fritz Henkel, the Company's founder'.

controles.affirmation: Henkel place les risques geopolitiques en tete de son tableau des risques majeurs et les qualifie de categorie la plus serieuse a court terme, en hausse du fait des conflits regionaux
controles.verbatim_source: in conjunction with the probability of occurrence, geopolitical risks represent the most serious risk category in the short-term forecast period ; Geopolitical risks have further increased due to ongoing regional conflicts such as in Africa/Middle East, Asia or Eastern Europe (Rapport annuel 2025, rapport risques et opportunites). L'ordre du tableau est confirme : 'A distinction is made between (geo)political, business-/industry-specific, financial, digital, environmental, social, governance, legal, and regulatory risks.'
